Fit the full download within its 28000-character limit (#295)

The full Clean Language download,
site/downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions.md, is subject to a hard
third-party limit of 28000 characters that cannot be raised. It held
28923 characters. This change removes 11 duplicated passages from the
skill sources and regenerates, which brings it to 27594 characters,
406 under the limit. This closes TODO 312.

Each cut passed a meaning test: every condition, criterion and
emphasis it carried stays stated in the download.

cleanlanguage/skills/cleanlanguage/SKILL.md:

- Core style, the bullet on marking a clause with `that`: the closing
  clause on why `the exception` misreads. The condition, the rule and
  both examples stay.
- Core style, the bullet on keeping the user's vocabulary: the clause
  on rewriting a phrase the user rejects as generated.
  anti-patterns.md states that rule in full.
- Removal list, formulaic executive phrasing: its 3 example phrases.
  anti-patterns.md lists each with a replacement.

cleanlanguage/skills/cleanlanguage/references/qa-checklist.md:

- Accuracy, the citation bullet: precedence rule 4 in SKILL.md holds
  the same list word for word.
- Directness, the 2 example phrases of the intensifier bullet: both
  stay in anti-patterns.md.
- Mechanics, the spelling-variant bullet: SKILL.md states the default,
  the condition for another variant and the consistency requirement.
- Mechanics, the `ensure` bullet: SKILL.md states the rule with the
  same recast as its example.
- Mechanics, the numerals bullet: SKILL.md states both criteria with
  worked examples.
- Mechanics, the closing-offer bullet: the SKILL.md rule also excludes
  generic invitations, so it is the wider rule.

cleanlanguage/skills/cleanlanguage/references/examples.md:

- Delete the framing: the second weak and preferred pair, on the
  threat landscape. The principle sentence and 2 pairs stay, and
  anti-patterns.md names the same cut.
- Replace executive template phrasing: the abstract-noun pair.
  SKILL.md states that rewrite as a rule, and anti-patterns.md as a
  table row.

Rename: the byte-equal twin that tools/build-portable-text.py writes
is now cleanlanguage-instructions-28k.md, because each size-labelled
file must be within its label; the 29k file is removed. In
site/_redirects, written by redirects_body() in
tools/set-release-links.py, a new 302 rule sends the old twin path to
the 28k file, and the alias /downloads/cleanlanguage-29k.md now
targets the 28k file. site/_headers, site-src/site.json,
site-src/pages/instructions.html, site/README.md, .aiqt/gensrc.json
and the portable-text-sync workflow comment name the 28k file.

The check: tools/check-portable-text-sync.sh now fails when the full
file holds more than 28000 characters by wc -m, down from 29000. Its
case 10 in tools/test-portable-text-release-date.sh pads a fixture to
28000 characters, which passes, and to 28001, which fails with the
label line. tools/test-release-links.py now expects 15 fixed redirect
lines and 5 renames, and tools/test-skill-release-date.py names the
28k twin. Because site/_redirects is 1 line longer,
tools/test-install-page.py expects a rule its cases append at line 38
and reads the first 15 lines as the release lines.

Regenerated with the repository tools, never by hand: both downloads
by tools/build-portable-text.py; site/index.html and the index.html
under site/install, site/instructions, site/examples and
site/checklist by tools/build-site.py, after their modified dates in
site-src/site.json moved to 2026-11-27; site/sitemap.xml by
tools/generate-sitemap.py --write; and
tools/portable-text-skill-source.sha256 by
tools/check-portable-text-sync.sh --update --force.

Add this message as .github/squash/295.txt, the committed squash
message that the Pull request text gate reads.

Deliberately unchanged: the hand-maintained 11k and 8k renderings, at
10998 and 7996 characters, which already carry the governing rules in
condensed form, hence --force; the canonical download URL; the
checklist dash bullet, which tools/check-skill-consistency.py
requires to match SKILL.md; the checklist bullet on adding a missing
`that`, which holds its own exclusion; and
site-src/pages/standard.html, which quotes 2 removed phrases whose
rules stay in SKILL.md. No second bound is added to
tools/build-portable-text.py, so the limit lives in 1 place.

Checks, each run from the repository root, a Python tool with
python3 -I; each exits 0:

- wc -m site/downloads/cleanlanguage-instructions*.md gives the full
  file and the 28k twin the same count, and the 11k and 8k files the
  counts above.
- tools/build-portable-text.py --check prints nothing.
- bash tools/check-portable-text-sync.sh prints that the portable
  files are reconciled with the skill source.
- bash tools/test-portable-text-release-date.sh ends with "All
  Released-line sync gate cases passed."
- tools/test-skill-release-date.py (76 tests),
  tools/test-skill-release-date-client.py (45),
  tools/test-release-links.py (93), tools/test-page-metadata.py (154),
  tools/test-web-metadata.py (65), tools/test-sitemap.py (41) and
  tools/test-headers.py (60) each end OK.
- tools/test-check-skill-consistency.py passes 213 cases,
  tools/test-instructions-page.py 119 and tools/test-build-site.py
  1122.
- tools/check-skill-consistency.py, tools/check-instructions-page.py,
  tools/build-site.py --check, tools/check-release-links.py,
  tools/check-links.py, tools/generate-sitemap.py,
  tools/check-headers.py, tools/test-pages-build.py, bash
  tools/pages-build.sh, tools/check-inline-code.py,
  tools/check-skill-discovery.py, tools/check-install-page.py,
  tools/test-install-page.py (623 cases) and
  tools/test-run-all-checks.py each pass.

tools/check-page-metadata.py and tools/test-no-qa-labels.py read git
history, so they need a git checkout; this change was prepared in a
plain export, where both fail at their git calls.
